messages:
nicole: quick check  compact mode for spend cards: should the legend be inline compact rows or a single overflow menu? prototype attached.
brad: overflow saves space and prevents visual noise. inline compact works if we limit to 2 series only.
tasneem: most orgs have >3 series (org, reserved, burst). overflow makes sense. but make current selection visible as chips: e.g., 'Org • Reserved' so context stays.
nicole: good call. chips should be text-only (no swatch) to reduce clutter. swatches live in the overflow panel with toggles.
brad: accessibility: overflow panel must trap focus and announce "Chart legend panel opened" via aria-live.
tasneem: also ensure keyboard shortcut to open legend panel (e.g., press 'L') and include hint in tooltip.
ui-bot: Prototype updated by @nicole: https://figma.com/file/unique123  frame pinned.
nicole: invoice CTA: small usability issue where "Download" ambiguity led to CSV asks. change to explicit verbs: "Download invoice (PDF)" and secondary link "Export ledger (CSV)".
brad: add tiny helper text under button: "PDF is per invoice; CSV is a ledger for accounting". keeps modal compact.
tasneem: color contrast nit: chips use a low-contrast gray on selected state. bump to #2b2b2b for 14px.
nicole: i'll update proto: overflow legend, visible chips summary, legend panel with swatches and toggles, 'L' shortcut, explicit invoice CTAs, helper copy, contrast fixes. moving to backlog if no objections.
brad: no objections.
tasneem: +1, will run quick keyboard nav test when dev build is ready."
